text:
Tennessine (atomic number 117) is a manufactured element that is below astatine in Group VII of
the Periodic Table.
What is the expected state of tennessine at room temperature and pressure?
A
a diatomic gas
B
a liquid
C
a monatomic gas
D
a solid
subject: Chemistry
